issue_request: FHIR-47389 asked to clarify Task boundaries so Task.input does not imply Task declares data requirements, and also raised broader workflow-definition relationship guidance. initial_application: The issue was applied by e9666ea49c00f77cd7020e6db3fd15cbafb76448 and merged by 96b43dd673881d8945721e3f82aae3cb6e7ab8f7 in PR #3551, changing source/task/task-introduction.xml from 'may or must be present' to the voted replacement wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists task=Task, so source/task/task-introduction.xml is build-scope source. OO 2025-05-09 minutes record a 7-0-0 motion for the paragraph replacement only. FHIR-40499 separately covers Task instantiates[x] and workflow-instantiates extension guidance, so broader PlanDefinition/ActivityDefinition/RequestOrchestration prose should not be added under FHIR-47389 without a separate decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active Task introduction already contains the approved paragraph: inputs are information provided for a task to be completed and outputs are results produced while performing a task.
